title: EigenBench: A Comparative Behavioral Measure of Value Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking language models against specific subjective value systems (e.g., Conservatism, Deep Ecology, Universal Kindness) using an ensemble of peer LLMs to judge response alignment to custom ideological constitutions.

Measuring primacy and recency order bias in LLM-as-a-judge evaluations by presenting candidate responses in both possible orders and calculating the proportion of times the judge systematically prefers the first or second position.

Testing the robustness of the evaluation framework against adversarial manipulation by injecting personas that are instructed to systematically generate and favor responses containing a secret signal word.
